description:
Your legal team has notified you that sales of laptops to California addresses are subject to a mandatory $12.50 E-Waste Recycling Fee. You need to enable the Fixed Product Tax (FPT) system in Magento, create a new attribute for this fee, and apply it to the 'Business Laptop Pro'.

Goal: Configure the Magento store to charge a $12.50 Electronic Waste Fee for customers in California when purchasing the 'Business Laptop Pro'.

Expected Actions:
1. Enable Fixed Product Taxes in Stores > Configuration > Sales > Tax.
2. Create a new Product Attribute with code 'california_ewaste_fee', label 'CA E-Waste Fee', and Catalog Input Type 'Fixed Product Tax'.
3. Assign this attribute to the Default Attribute Set.
4. Edit the 'Business Laptop Pro' product and add a tax rule for California (US) with a value of $12.50.

Note: If not logged in, use credentials: admin / Admin1234!
